heading: We blend the tea ourselves
body: Lotus, jasmine and oolong, blended in the shop and weighed into 100g and 250g tins at the counter.

heading: A few tables inside
body: Sit down and drink a pot instead of taking a tin away. We keep pouring while the leaf gives.

heading: Bought at the counter
body: We do not sell online. Come to 58 Quán Thánh any day between 8:00 and 21:00, or call and we will put a tin aside.
